brief:
An Israeli court has upheld the detention of Palestinian land activist Ghassan Najjar, Al Jazeera English reported. Najjar, who defends Palestinian land rights in the occupied West Bank, will remain in custody until at least February 26, 2025.

The ruling extends Najjar's detention as legal proceedings against him continue. Details of the charges and grounds for his arrest were not specified in the available reporting.
dek: Occupied West Bank land defender is set to remain in detention until at least February 26 next year.
title: Israeli court upholds detention of Palestinian land activist Najjar
